questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 1 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.A: All trivia teams in the tournament that scored 14 or more points in the round
choices.B: The 55 trivia teams in the sample
choices.C: The 40 trivia teams in the sample that practiced for at least 3 hours per week
choices.D: All trivia teams in the tournament

ledger.recompute: 55 队随机抽自该 tournament 全部队 → 可推广至 tournament 全部 trivia teams；表内 40 队只是子集展示。选 D。

questions.stem: A trivia tournament organizer wanted to study the relationship between the number of points a team scores in a trivia round and the number of hours that a team practices each week. For the study, the organizer selected 55 teams at random from all trivia teams in a certain tournament. The table displays the information for the 40 teams in the sample that practiced for at least 3 hours per week. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the study can be generalized?

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 2 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.A: All the 50 baobab trees that were selected in this habitat
choices.B: All the baobab trees that were 19 years old in this habitat
choices.C: All the baobab trees that were 17 years old in South Africa
choices.D: All the baobab trees that were 17 years old in this habitat

ledger.recompute: 抽样框=该 habitat 内 17 岁树 → 推广限于本组（不扩到全南非、不扩到 19 岁）。选 D。

questions.stem: For a baobab tree habitat in South Africa, a scientist randomly selected 50 baobab trees that were 17 years old and randomly assigned them to two groups. Each group was subjected to a different watering pattern for 2 consecutive years to observe whether the watering pattern affects the trees' growth rate. Based on the design of the study, what is the largest group to which these results can be applied?

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 3 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.B: All fourth-grade students at the school
choices.D: All fourth-grade students in the county in which the school is located

ledger.recompute: 随机抽自该校四年级 → 最大总体=该校全体四年级生（32 人数字仅背景）。选 B。

questions.stem: A sample of 40 fourth-grade students was selected at random from a certain school. The 40 students completed a survey about the morning announcements, and 32 thought the announcements were helpful. Which of the following is the largest population to which the results of the survey can be applied?

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 4 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.C: All middle school students in the city

ledger.recompute: 抽样框=该校全体学生（单一中学）→ 推广限于该校学生；不扩到全市中学生。选 B。

questions.stem: A psychologist designed and conducted a study to determine whether playing a certain educational game increases middle school students' accuracy in adding fractions. For the study, the psychologist chose a random sample of 35 students from all of the students at one of the middle schools in a large city. The psychologist found that students who played the game showed significant improvement in accuracy when adding fractions. What is the largest group to which the results of the study can be generalized?

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 5 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.A: The percentages do not add up to 100%, so any possible conclusions from the poll are invalid.
choices.B: Those who responded to the poll were not a random sample of the population of the United States.
choices.C: There were not 50% "Yes" responses and 50% "No" responses.
choices.D: The show did not allow viewers enough time to respond to the poll.

ledger.recompute: 自愿回应（voluntary response）网调 → 非随机样本，不能代表全美；28%+70%=98% 属未答/无效，非无效理由。选 B。

questions.stem: Near the end of a US cable news show, the host invited viewers to respond to a poll on the show's website that asked, "Do you support the new federal policy discussed during the show?" At the end of the show, the host reported that 28% responded "Yes," and 70% responded "No." Which of the following best explains why the results are unlikely to represent the sentiments of the population of the United States?

questions.topic: 专项练习 · Topic 23 · 第 6 题
questions.paper: 03 Problem Solving and Data Analysis 专项练习（重录）

choices.A: The mean number of children per household in the community is 2.4.
choices.B: A determination about the mean number of children per household in the community should not be made because the sample size is too small.
choices.C: The sampling method is flawed and may produce a biased estimate of the mean number of children per household in the community.
choices.D: The sampling method is not flawed and is likely to produce an unbiased estimate of the mean number of children per household in the community.

ledger.recompute: 游乐场便利抽样（带娃家庭偏多）→ 方法有偏，可能高估；不能直接当总体均值。选 C。（旧 U2-13 同题，旧答案 C 一致；题干选项全同，无图。）

questions.stem: To determine the mean number of children per household in a community, Tabitha surveyed 20 families at a playground. For the 20 families surveyed, the mean number of children per household was 2.4. Which of the following statements must be true?
